title: C27 - Next Independent USDT-Perp Venue Out-of-Sample Replication of the frozen crash-rebound edge
why_c27: C24 established the d15 margin/liquidation-fidelity adjudication (PASS, consolidated NO_GO superseding C1-C23). C25/C26 adjudicate cost/funding and intrabar-path fidelity on the SAME four venues (OKX, Binance UM, MEXC, Bitget). C27 asks the mandatory successor question: does the unchanged spec-literal edge replicate on a NEVER-USED USDT-perp venue (Bybit primary; fallback candidates named by the stage-0 probe)? This is new data + a frozen spec, not a same-data rerun and not a parameter search. C27-T1 may NOT launch until C26 ACCEPTANCE: PASS; C26 may NOT launch until C25 ACCEPTANCE: PASS; C25 is IN FLIGHT (runner alive, 1/56 cells, ETA ~2026-11-28).
research_question: Does the frozen spec-literal crash-rebound edge produce a consistent sign on an independent, never-used USDT-perp venue across four folds, under the C25/C26 fidelity apparatus (cost_taker_funding primary arm), versus the recorded OKX/Binance/MEXC/Bitget NO_GO priors?
blocked_on: C26-T1 (intrabar path & per-trade funding fidelity) which is itself blocked on C25-T1 (round-trip cost & realized-funding fidelity). C27 build (probe + prereg) may proceed before C25/C26 pass, but no C27 cell may run until C26 ACCEPTANCE: PASS.
acquisition_gate: Stage-0 probe scripts/probe_c27_venue_acquisition.py must return c27_data_status starting with ACQUISITION_VIABLE_* before any C27 compute. If it returns ACQUISITION_BLOCKED_BY_API_RETENTION (or equivalent), C27 is blocked for multiyear replication; the only legitimate alternative is a new pre-registered hypothesis on new data, never a same-data rerun.
new_venue: TBD by scripts/probe_c27_venue_acquisition.py (Bybit primary candidate; OKX/Binance UM/MEXC/Bitget already used; Hyperliquid-native CLOSED: FULL_283D_BLOCKED_BY_API_RETENTION)

signal_path_frozen.drift_rule: Any artifact whose signal_path/cost/funding fields differ from this prereg are INVALID. The new-venue config is frozen to these spec-literal values; no parameter tuning after results.

path_base.why: C25 primary-arm model (venue-mean scalar funding, next-open fills). Anchor reproduces the C25 cost_taker_funding per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0 on shared venues; on the new venue it establishes the baseline.

cost_taker_funding.why: C25 primary arm: realized venue-mean funding scalar + 5 bps/side slippage + venue taker bps. The C27 adjudication arm on the new venue.

path_intrabar_combined.why: Per-trade realized funding AND conservative intrabar adverse-first sequencing together (C26 primary), applied to the new venue for robustness.

inference.draw_floors: 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo / 2k strata; do not reduce
inference.power_floor: >= 10 trades / >= 5 episodes / >= 5 distinct crash days per fold; otherwise UNDERPOWERED with a power curve

decision_rules.STABLE_POSITIVE_SUBSET: >=1 pre-specified venue-fold or pooled stratum survives BH correction with bootstrap CI95 excluding 0 & positive spot leg, permutation p<0.05, placebo p_ge<0.05, effective N>=floor, AND same-direction effect corroborated vs recorded priors or flagged single-venue exploratory.
decision_rules.NO_GO: no stratum survives BH correction; pooled CI95 spans 0; spot non-positive across most folds (corroborates the C1-C26 NO_GO).
decision_rules.UNDERPOWERED: per-fold N below floor, or missing seed/SHA binding, or compute predating this prereg, or acquisition gate not passed.

guardrails: Cross-venue real USDT-perp data only; never relabel as Hyperliquid (is_hyperliquid_venue_data=false for C20-C27).
Config is FROZEN to the spec-literal values above; no parameter tuning after results.
Folds and strata fixed here, before compute; no post-hoc bin/fold invention.

No synthetic gap-fill; symbols not listed for the full window are excluded (coverage=false), never fabricated.

Report per-fold, per-venue, and pooled numbers plus the power curve — never a bare token.
